terms.label: Rest edge
terms.unit: per day more rest than the other side

terms.label: Travel edge
terms.unit: per 1,000 miles less travel since its last game

terms.label: Backup QB
terms.unit: when the other side starts a backup quarterback, by how much worse he is

terms.label: Altitude
terms.unit: per 1,000 meters the home field sits above the visitors' own (Denver)

terms.label: Neutral-script EPA
terms.unit: per 0.1 EPA a play better (offense less defense allowed) this season, garbage time left out

terms.label: Line continuity
terms.unit: per offensive-line starter the other side changed since its last game, less its own

terms.label: Division game
terms.unit: to the home edge in a division game (the teams know each other)

terms.label: Body clock
terms.unit: when the other side kicks off before 11 a.m. by its own home clock, less its own

terms.label: Surface
terms.unit: when the other side plays on a field of the other kind (grass or turf) from its home field's, less its own

terms.label: New head coach
terms.unit: when the other side is in its first three games under a new head coach, less its own

terms.label: Coach fired midseason
terms.unit: when the other side is in its first three games under a head coach who took over during the season (an interim), less its own

terms.label: Officials (home lean)
terms.unit: per point (run, goal) a game the home side has beaten the teams' own margins with this crew

terms.label: Last season's EPA
terms.unit: per 0.1 EPA a play better (offense less defense) last season

terms.label: Last season's line grade
terms.unit: per 5 points better offensive line grade (the ranker's) last season

terms.label: Last season's weapons grade
terms.unit: per 5 points better weapons grade (the ranker's) last season

terms.label: Last season's pass rush
terms.unit: per 10 points more pressure on the passer last season

terms.label: Backup QBs (total)
terms.unit: to the total per backup quarterback starting, by how much worse he is

terms.label: Cold
terms.unit: to the total per 10°F below 50°F (outdoors)

terms.label: Wind
terms.unit: to the total per 10 mph of wind over 5 (outdoors)

terms.label: Rain or snow
terms.unit: to the total per 0.1 inch of rain and melted snow from the hour before kickoff through the third after (outdoors)

terms.label: Snow
terms.unit: to the total per inch of snowfall over the same hours (outdoors)

terms.label: Neutral-script EPA (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 0.1 EPA a play of both offenses and both defenses' allowed

terms.label: Crosswind
terms.unit: to the total per 10 mph of wind across the field over 10 (outdoors)

terms.label: Pass funnels (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 10 points of both defenses' pass funnel (their opponents' pass rate over expected against them, in neutral situations, over their own)

terms.label: Defenses' pace (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 10% more plays both defenses' opponents run against them than they usually do

terms.label: Division game (total)
terms.unit: to the total in a division game

terms.label: Officials (total)
terms.unit: per point (run, goal) a game its crew has run over what the teams usually score

terms.label: Officials (whistle)
terms.unit: per flag a game more than average its referee calls

terms.label: Last season's EPA (total)
terms.unit: to the total per 0.1 EPA a play of both offenses and both defenses' allowed
